description: This file defines interfaces, constants, and a data class related to distributed grain communication and streaming in an Orleans-based project.

classes.name: StreamingConstants
classes.description: A static class containing string constants for streaming provider, namespace, and default counter grain.

classes.name: ReportingOptions
classes.description: A data class with properties for report timing and duration.

methods.name: GetCounterValue
methods.description: Asynchronous method to retrieve the value of a specified counter.

methods.name: Track
methods.description: Asynchronous method to track a grain with a counter.

methods.name: GetRunDuration
methods.description: Asynchronous method to get the duration of a grain's run.

methods.name: WaitTimeForReport
methods.description: Asynchronous method to get the wait time before reporting.

methods.name: GetTotalCounterValue
methods.description: Asynchronous method to get the total value of a counter.
